name:
Custom Tabs' Bookmarks tab removed by hand, in the je sandbox: as admin, Custom Tabs' own settings page, the 'Bookmarks' tab (
) removed with its Remove button and the page saved, as an admin deletes it by hand. bookmarks-je-web-probe.mjs runs it while Jellyfin Enhanced's Bookmarks is off (set through its API, so the tab it owns is still there) and then checks that nothing puts the tab back.

steps.name: its tabs loaded
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#customTabsConfigurationPage'); if (!p) return false; const sets = Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('[data-id=tab-config]')); return sets.length === __vars.before.length && sets.length > 0 ? sets.map(s => s.querySelector('[data-id=txtDisplayText]').value) : false; })()

steps.name: remove the Bookmarks tab with its Remove button
steps.script:
const p = document.querySelector('#customTabsConfigurationPage'); const set = Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('[data-id=tab-config]')).find(s => s.querySelector('[data-id=templateHtmlContent]').value.trim() === '
'); if (!set) throw new Error('no Bookmarks tab on the page'); set.querySelector('[data-id=templateRemoveTab]').click(); return p.querySelectorAll('[data-id=tab-config]').length;

steps.name: the tab is gone from the page
saved: Custom Tabs no longer has the tab
steps.waitFor:
(async () => { const t = (await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration('fbacd0b6-fd46-4a05-b0a4-2045d6a135b0')).Tabs; return t.length === __vars.before.length - 1 && !t.some(x => String(x.ContentHtml).trim() === '
') ? t.map(x => x.Title) : false; })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, jellyfin-web's Home tab slider, and jellyfin-web's emby-input upgrading Custom Tabs' tab fields, whose template has two labels for one input, excepted)
steps.ignore: /CustomRatings/script|^TypeError: t\.value\.pause is not a function|^TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined \(setting 'htmlFor'\)
